newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines' T-bill auction postponed due to rain.
newsitem.headline: Philippines' T-bill auction postponed due to rain.

text.p: The Philippines' Bureau of Treasury said on Monday it had postponed its weekly Treasury bill auction scheduled at noon until Tuesday.
Treasury officials said the auction was postponed because there was no power in the building.
"We will have the auction tomorrow, while the ten-year auction scheduled on Tuesday has been moved to Wednesday," the official said.
Three days of heavy rains have brought the capital and its financial markets to a virtual standstill.
